2. Compare that with the top scorer of Manchester United in the Premier League (i.e., the club's all-time top scorer in Premier League).
3. Who was the top scorer of the Premier League in the 2019-2020 season.

- player_stats_get_all_time_goals: get all-time goals for a player for a team in a competition. We can use it for Cristiano Ronaldo, team Manchester United, competition Premier League.

- team_stats_get_top_scorer: get top scorer of a specified football team. We can use it for Manchester United, competition Premier League. That will give us the top scorer and presumably number of goals.

- league_stats_get_top_scorer: get top scorer of a specified football league. Use for Premier League, season 2019-2020.
